_about: Hand-written content for ordelo-database-guide.{md,html}. Everything else in the guide is read from the SQL file headers. Every object named in 'flows' must exist in a SQL file or in external_objects.json (tests/test_datamodels_standard.py). Rebuild: python scripts/datamodels/build_guide.py

capabilities.title: Core master data
capabilities.summary: Restaurants, customers, riders, menus and the key/value runtime configuration (ordelo_config) that every other area reads.

capabilities.title: Ordering and web checkout
capabilities.summary: Creating an order and its items in one transaction, the columns OrdeloAgent adds to restaurant-agents' food_order, and the web checkout tables (session draft, idempotency, page tokens, rate limit, payment release, daily audit).

capabilities.title: Payment
capabilities.summary: The payment inbox (payment_event), the at-most-once authorisation step and the alert-only reconciler for paid orders that never started fulfilment.

capabilities.title: Customer notifications
capabilities.summary: Who hears about an order (subscriptions), what happened (customer events) and one delivery record per event and subscription (outbox).

capabilities.title: Delivery orders
capabilities.summary: The delivery order as fulfilment sees it (delivery_summary), its priced vehicle options and the 5-second job that opens the next option or times the order out.

capabilities.title: Rider dispatch
capabilities.summary: Offering jobs to riders, assigning the first acceptance, the in-flight job, completion and cancellation, and the rider pickup reminder sweep.

capabilities.title: Takeaway (collection)
capabilities.summary: The collection order (takeaway_summary), its creation and the triggers that tell admins and customers about it.

capabilities.title: Restaurant admin actions
capabilities.summary: Rules shared by WhatsApp and Telegram: accept / decline, pickup time, Ready and +10 / +20, the confirmation timeout and the daily availability question.

capabilities.title: Telegram layer
capabilities.summary: Invite links, the at-most-once update inbox, order cards with reminders, the ledger of sent messages and the daily purge.

capabilities.title: Rider location
capabilities.summary: OwnTracks GPS fixes and region events from a pgmq queue, and on-demand WhatsApp location requests.

capabilities.title: Agent threads
capabilities.summary: Reading LangGraph checkpoints and closing idle conversation threads (OrdeloAgent and restaurant-agents).

capabilities.title: Admin dashboard
capabilities.summary: Magic-link sessions, the order views behind the restaurant dashboard and the rider payout report.

capabilities.title: Platform and operations
capabilities.summary: HTTP helpers, cron housekeeping and the Fly.io / AWS App Runner switches.

capabilities.title: Byteloop agent
capabilities.summary: Tables and vector search used by the separate Byteloop agent.

capabilities.title: Test support
capabilities.summary: Helpers and harness scripts for resetting and replaying orders. Not part of production flows.

capabilities.title: Orphan candidates
capabilities.summary: Live objects with no caller found in OrdeloAgent, restaurant-frontend or restaurant-agents. Captured exactly as live; keep or drop is an owner decision (docs/to-do.md).

capabilities.title: Migrations (history)
capabilities.summary: Frozen one-off change scripts. Their statements are history; the current definition of every object is in its capability folder.

flows.title: Order creation and payment
flows.summary: Both channels create the order the same way; payment authorisation is applied once and then starts fulfilment.

steps.title: Basket to order
steps.text: WhatsApp (restaurant-agents) or the web checkout allocates an order number with get_next_daily_seq() and calls create_food_order_with_items(): food_order and order_item in one transaction. The web path also writes web_session_meta and web_order_request (idempotency).

steps.title: Payment link
steps.text: Python asks the payment service for a link. Web orders get a page token in order_access_grant for tracking.

steps.title: Authorisation
steps.text: The payment callback calls record_payment_authorised(): a payment_event row per provider event and food_order.payment_status requires_payment -> requires_capture, at most once.

steps.title: Start fulfilment
steps.text: /payment-hooks/payment-complete calls init_delivery() or init_takeaway(); see the delivery and takeaway flows.

steps.title: Safety net
steps.text: job_payment_init_reconciler() would alert overwatch about paid orders with no summary row. It is NOT scheduled on live (docs/to-do.md).

steps.title: Late or failed web payments
steps.text: Cancellations that must be retried are queued in web_payment_release and worked by the Python lifecycle sweeper.

flows.title: Delivery order, from payment to doorstep
flows.summary: Statuses live in delivery_summary.status. Three 5-second cron jobs move an order from restaurant confirmation to an assigned rider.

steps.title: 1 Create
steps.text: init_delivery() inserts the summary: 'restaurant_unconfirmed', or 'unassigned' with a pickup time when resolve_initial_restaurant_acceptance() says the restaurant auto-accepts.

steps.title: 2 Confirm
steps.text: trigger_restaurant_updates POSTs /delivery-hooks/restaurant-confirmation-request; admins answer by WhatsApp or Telegram. restaurant_order_decide() and restaurant_order_set_pickup() record the answer; process_restaurant_confirmation() (10 s) times out unanswered orders.

steps.title: 3 Options
steps.text: process_delivery() (5 s) opens one delivery_detail row per vehicle type by delivery_option rank, and marks the order 'timedout' when every vehicle type timed out (trigger -> /delivery-hooks/delivery-timedout).

steps.title: 4 Offers
steps.text: job_create_dispatch() (5 s) inserts delivery_dispatch offers for get_available_riders(); the statement trigger POSTs /delivery-hooks/delivery-dispatch and riders get a WhatsApp offer.

steps.title: 5 Assign
steps.text: job_assign_dispatch() (5 s) gives the order to the first acceptance (assign_accepted_dispatch): dispatch, detail and summary 'assigned' and a delivery_inflight row, whose trigger starts the rider agent. notify_missed_dispatches() tells the other riders.

steps.title: 6 Deliver
steps.text: The rider agent checks the pickup code; dispatch_cancel_before_pickup() re-offers the order; dispatch_complete_func() marks everything 'completed' and removes the inflight row. job_rider_pickup_alerts() nudges riders around pickup time.

flows.title: Takeaway (collection) order
flows.summary: Statuses live in takeaway_summary.status: restaurant_unconfirmed -> pickup_confirmed -> completed, or declined.

steps.title: 1 Create
steps.text: /takeaway-hooks/init-takeaway-order calls init_takeaway(): 'restaurant_unconfirmed', or 'pickup_confirmed' with a pickup time on auto-accept.

steps.title: 2 Confirm
steps.text: trigger_takeaway_restaurant_updates POSTs /takeaway-hooks/restaurant-confirmation-request; the same decision rules as delivery record the answer; process_restaurant_confirmation() times out unanswered orders.

steps.title: 3 Notify
steps.text: The first pickup_time (on update or at insert) fires trigger_takeaway_pickup_time_set / _insert -> /takeaway-hooks/pickup-time-updated, so the customer is told when to collect.

steps.title: 4 Ready
steps.text: restaurant_order_ready() (WhatsApp or Telegram Ready) sets ready_at / ready_by and the customer is told.

flows.title: Restaurant admin decisions and kitchen actions
flows.summary: One set of SQL rules for both channels. The Telegram wrappers authorise the tapping admin first.

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: restaurant_order_decide() records accept / decline ('declined' is terminal); restaurant_order_set_pickup() sets the pickup time. t_order_decide() / t_order_set_pickup() check t_order_admin_phone() first.

steps.title: Time out
steps.text: process_restaurant_confirmation() (10 s) marks unanswered orders 'restaurant_timedout'; Python then sets a default pickup time.

steps.title: Ready, +10, +20
steps.text: Once a rider has the job, restaurant_order_ready() (first tap per dispatch wins) and restaurant_order_adjust_pickup() (relative to pickup_time_initial). Telegram wrappers: t_order_ready(), t_order_adjust_pickup().

steps.title: Kitchen receipts
steps.text: Telegram receipts are t_sent_messages rows of kind 'receipt'; job_t_receipt_refresh() (5 s) finds stale copies with t_receipts_stale() / t_receipts_take() and Python edits them.

steps.title: Daily availability
steps.text: enquire_admin_availability() asks each restaurant's admins every morning whether they are open.

flows.title: Telegram layer
flows.summary: Admins link their Telegram account through an invite; every update is handled at most once; order cards follow the database.

steps.title: Invite
steps.text: The operator inserts a t_invites row and copies invite_link from t_invites_shareable. /start <code> calls t_invite_preview(); 'Yes' calls t_claim_invite(); /whoami calls t_linked_restaurants().

steps.title: Inbox
steps.text: Each Telegram update is claimed once with t_inbox_claim() and closed with t_inbox_finish(), so retries across workers are skipped.

steps.title: Order cards
steps.text: job_t_order_alerts() (5 s) seeds t_order_alerts checkpoints for unconfirmed orders, picks the due reminder and stale copies, and POSTs them to the app, which sends or edits cards and records them with t_order_card_sent() / t_order_card_mark().

steps.title: Housekeeping
steps.text: t_housekeeping() purges old inbox, ledger and alert rows. It is NOT scheduled on live (docs/to-do.md).

flows.title: Rider location
flows.summary: Continuous tracking from the OwnTracks app, plus on-demand WhatsApp location requests.

steps.title: Queue
steps.text: OwnTracks messages land in the pgmq queue 'owntracks'. job_process_owntracks() (30 s) moves GPS fixes to rider_location and region events to rider_location_event.

steps.title: Events
steps.text: trigger_rider_location_event_update POSTs every region event to /location-hooks/notify-rider-location-event.

steps.title: Missing fixes
steps.text: job_null_or_outdated_location() would alert about live jobs with no recent fix; its cron job is INACTIVE.

steps.title: On demand
steps.text: A customer or admin asks where the rider is: wa_location_request (pending) -> WhatsApp prompt -> the rider shares -> wa_location_observation -> requests fulfilled.

flows.title: Customer notifications
flows.summary: utils_common/notify/customer_notifier.py writes events and delivers them through the outbox.

steps.title: Subscribe
steps.text: Web orders get a 'web_page' subscription with no destination; WhatsApp customers get 'whatsapp_restaurant'.

steps.title: Record
steps.text: One order_customer_event per order and deterministic event key.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: One notification_outbox row per event and subscription, claimed before any I/O; web-page delivery is a no-op because the page reads events.

flows.title: Agent threads
flows.summary: thread is owned by restaurant-agents; LangGraph writes the checkpoint tables. OrdeloAgent reads state and closes idle threads.

steps.title: Read state
steps.text: get_latest_state() / get_latest_state_by_thread() return a thread's latest checkpoint as JSON.

steps.title: Close idle OrdeloAgent threads
steps.text: job_close_thread() finds threads idle longer than THREAD_INACTIVE_TIME_INTERVAL and POSTs them to /delivery-hooks/close-threads. Python (delivery_hooks.py) calls it; pg_cron does not.

steps.title: Terminate idle restaurant threads
steps.text: job_terminate_stale_active_threads_new() (every minute, job 'jobTerminateStaleActiveThreadsNew') POSTs per restaurant to restaurant-agents.

flows.title: Dashboard and operations
flows.summary: Admin dashboard reads and platform helpers.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.text: Magic-link logins in auth_sessions; orders from v_admin_orders and its daily / monthly totals; get_rider_payout_report() for payouts.

steps.title: Daily rider question
steps.text: enquire_shift_availability() asks every active rider whether they are working today.

steps.title: HTTP helpers
steps.text: ordelo_post() builds a URL from an ordelo_config key; fly_post() drives Fly.io machines with tokens from fly_config (security finding in docs/to-do.md).

steps.title: Switches
steps.text: job_awsrunner_switch() pauses or resumes AWS App Runner; both cron jobs are INACTIVE.
